description_en: Queries a list of tags of media assets in the public media library
description_zh: 列出公共素材库媒资的所有标签
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-all-public-media-tags --business-type sticker --entity-id Copyright_Music --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAllPublicMediaTags

parameters.help_en: The business type of the media asset
parameters.name: business_type

parameters.help_en:
The entity ID, which is used to distinguish between media assets of different types in the public domain.

Set this parameter to Copyright\_Music, which indicates music in the public domain
parameters.help_zh:
实体ID，用于区分不同种类的公共版权媒资。取值：

\- Copyright_Music: 公共版权音乐
parameters.name: entity_id
